method: Independent final AI comparison of all 212 retained definition/example/Slovak hint combinations. Read the full retained learner text and inspected deltas against the original 254-entry snapshot; separately retrieved the middle range when the tool output truncated it. Individually written original assessments remain for unchanged learner text, with new resolution assessments for all 15 retained translation changes and both Spanish-definition changes. No dataset edits by this reviewer. No human, native-speaker, legal, comprehensive dictionary or official CEFR approval claimed. CEFR placement is outside the Slovak-review scope.
